note: One line per test, review or fix, with who did it. Details of a finding are published once it is fixed and released; until then a line gives only how many were found and how serious they are. Severity, from worst: critical (a key reachable without your approval, or your own access to your data lost), high, medium, low, info. Code reviews and tests count bugs and security problems together.

entries.title: Lock could leave a volume mounted
entries.result: 1 medium: under load, macOS can briefly list a disk image without its devices, and sealctl lock then reported the volume closed while it stayed mounted; found by a CI test and fixed with tests.

entries.title: Timing and interruption tests
entries.result: 158 problems found with repeatable tests of clock changes, crossing messages and interrupted steps: 19 high, 64 medium, 74 low, 1 info; 138 fixed, including every high one and all but one medium.

entries.title: Code review of every repository
entries.result: 131 confirmed problems in 339 source files: 1 critical, 11 high, 43 medium, 76 low; 128 fixed, including every critical, high and medium one.

entries.title: Red team: relay and protocol
entries.result: No key reachable without approval; 1 medium, 2 low, 1 info; 3 fixed, 1 low open.

entries.title: Red team: command line tool and core
entries.result: No key reachable without approval; 1 medium and 2 low, all fixed; 2 info notes; 49 million fuzzed inputs to 12 parsers, no crash.

entries.title: Red team: Android app
entries.result: No key reachable without approval; 3 low, all fixed; 3 info notes.

entries.title: Automated code review of the command line tool
entries.who: GitHub Copilot code review; confirmed and fixed internally, AI-assisted (Claude)
entries.result: 1 high, 1 medium, 3 low, each fixed with a test.

entries.title: Supply chain: command line tool, apps, relay and website
entries.result: No malicious, hijacked or look-alike package among 405 crates for the command line tool, 318 for the apps and 308 npm packages; 2 high, 13 medium, 22 low, 22 info; 1 high, 2 medium and 2 low still open.

entries.title: Staging incident: retries after the relay refused a call
entries.result: 1 medium, fixed in the command line tool, the relay and both apps; 10 related medium follow-ups are still open.

continuous: From 23 November 2026, every change to the main branch of a public repository goes through a pull request and an independent review by a separate agent before merging (internal, AI-assisted).
The command line tool's parsers are fuzzed on every pull request that changes them, and nightly.

Dependencies: the command line tool's crates are checked on each pull request for known advisories, licences and sources (cargo deny) and against reviewed audits (cargo vet); the relay's and website's npm packages install only from the lockfile with registry signatures verified in CI; Dependabot reports advisories everywhere; routine updates wait 7 days after release (security updates don't wait).
Secret scanning with push protection on every public repository.
Shared protocol test vectors, checked byte for byte by the core, the relay and both apps.
Power-cut tests: unsealing is cut at every step and must resume without losing anything.
